description: Inferred (all-source, Alex 2026-11-24) from GAMBETTA-FAST-PACED-MULTIPLAYER-LAG-COMPENSATION: the summary of the client-server game architecture, and its techniques (the series parts). Lag compensation: the server reconstructs the world at the instant of a timestamped shot and processes the shot at that point in time.
